title: adenostemma lavenia var. parviflorum
intro: Adenostemma lavenia var. parviflorum, commonly known as Small-Flowered Adenostemma, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Adenostemma lavenia var. parviflorum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which can provide relief from respiratory infections and other health conditions.
